THE SUBPOENAS TO BAY DELTA MARINE AND JS CRESVALE INTERNATIONAL (NEWCAP PARTNERS) ARE MODIFIED TO ONLY REQUIRE PRODUCTION OF ANY MEDICAL RECORDS PERTAINING TO THE LEGS AND LOWER BACK AND ANY AND ALL PAYROLL RECORDS, 1099 FORMS IF APPLICABLE, AND W-2'S, AS WELL AS DOCUMENTS THAT REFLECT JOB TITLE, JOB DUTIES, AND DATES OF EMPLOYMENT. THE SUBPOENA TO SAN JOSE STATE UNIVERSITY IS MODIFIED TO ONLY REQUIRE PRODUCTION OF RECORDS INDICATING THE DATES OF ENROLLMENT, DEGREE ATTAINED, AND MEDICAL RECORDS PERTAINING TO THE LEGS AND LOWER BACK.
